Alt+Enter: Display properties for the selected item
Alt+Esc: Cycle through items in the order in which they were opened
Alt+F8: Show your password on the sign-in screen
Ctrl+D: Delete the selected item and move it to the Recycle Bin
Ctrl+TAB: Switch to next child window (MDI application)
Ctrl+Alt+TAB: Use arrow keys to switch between open windows
F6: Cycle through screen elements in a window or on the desktop
Win+1..9: Open the 1/2..9 app pinned to the taskbar
Win+H: Win 8: Open Share Charm / Win 10+: Speech Services
Win+Home: Toggle Minimize/Restore all but the active desktop window
Win+Left Arrow: Snap app to left of the screen
Win+PrtScn: Capture a screenshot and save in Screenshots folder
Win+Right Arrow: Snap app to right of the screen
Win+Shift+Down Arrow: Restore the stretched window to the top and bottom of the screen
Win+Shift+Left Arrow: Move window to monitor to the left
Win+Shift+Right Arrow: Move window to monitor to the right
Win+Shift+Up Arrow: Stretch window to the top and bottom of the screen
Win+T: Cycle through apps/pinned apps on the taskbar
